# AI agent builder playbook: tools, memory, multi-step reasoning

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' playbook for designing and building AI agents with tools, memory and multi-step reasoning: agent architecture (input → agent → output with tools, memory and knowledge layers), an agent-types table (reactive, conversational, tool-using, reasoning, multi-agent with complexity ratings), tool-calling patterns (tool definition YAML with parameters schema, common tool categories — data retrieval, actions, computation, generation — and an n8n agent workflow example), memory patterns (buffer, summary, vector and entity memory with implementations, plus context-window management strategies — sliding window, relevance-based, hierarchical — with a token budget), multi-step reasoning (ReAct thought/action/observation loops, a planning agent with plan → execute → synthesize steps), platform integrations (Slack bot with thread context, Telegram bot with voice/image/document handlers, web chat frontend/backend with JWT sessions), and ready-to-adapt agent templates (customer support agent with escalation triggers, research agent with sources-cited output), all illustrated with a worked "appointment scheduling agent" example. Works in English and Chinese; recommended models claude-opus-4/claude-sonnet-4. MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
